messages:
Maya P: FYI we got the replacement shipment from NexaSupply but warehouse flagged a bunch of units with missing/incorrect serials, so they're on hold. AWB pasted below. Can Nexa confirm manifest and advise on insurance next steps? :grimacing:

Maya P: AWB list (scanned by receiving):
```
AWB: 860-1234567 - 4 units - SERIALS:  - , -, 7X23-??, 8Y11-AAA
AWB: 860-1234568 - 2 units - SERIALS: N/A, N/A
AWB: 860-1234570 - 1 unit - SERIAL: 9Z01-VALID
```

ops-bot: RMA ticket RMA-9923 created and linked to shipment 860-1234567/68/70. Assigned to Tara - Logistics.

NexaSupply - Laura: Sorry about that — we're seeing an internal packing manifest mismatch. We can re-run a verification and reissue a signed manifest within 48 hours. For insurance, do you want us to open a carrier claim or issue replacement units first?

Tara - Logistics: Carrier wants signed serial manifest to clear customs/warehouse. If Nexa can provide corrected manifest and scanned packing list we can release 68% of the non-blank units. For the blank serials we need an explicit disposition: replace, credit, or documented test that ties units to batch.

Aj (SRE): Heads up — we have 3 pending jobs that need 8x A100 equivalents. Holding these units delays capacity by ~12 hours if we can't stage replacements. Can we get expedited air for the replacements if needed?

NexaSupply - Laura: We can prioritize a partial air-replace for the 3 units with blank serials. Cost delta ~ $1.2k per unit for next-day air EU->US. We can also recheck labels and provide container-level photos to avoid re-shipping. Which do you prefer?

Maya P: Short-term we need capacity. If air-replace gets them to the staging rack within 24h, do it. We'll take the delta charge on the company card but we need a formal invoice and insurance claim trail. Please confirm AWB for the air leg when booked. :+1:

Liam (Ops): Also confirm HS code and declared value for customs — carrier flagged missing HS on 860-1234568 which slowed processing. Nexa, can you resend commercial invoice with HS and line-item values?

NexaSupply - Laura: Confirmed — resending commercial invoice and corrected manifest now. Declared value updated to match original PO. Air AWB for expedited 3 units will be 860-1234599 (expected ETA 24h) once customs docs are refiled.

Tara - Logistics: Glad to hear. Next: insurance — do we file a claim against the ocean/air carrier or do you provide a replacement credit right away? We need the timeline for settlement; warehouse won't accept without either replacement or indemnity letter.

NexaSupply - Laura: We can issue a proforma replacement and start carrier claim in parallel. We'll provide indemnity letter for the warehouse to allow temporary acceptance under bonded hold until the claim settles. I'll attach scanned docs in this thread.

Aj (SRE): Quick ask — can you tag the three expedited units with temporary serials so our provisioning scripts can stage them? We only need stable identifiers to allocate in cluster inventory, we can swap to final serials after manifest finalization.

Maya P: Yes please. Tagged temporary IDs are fine — we need them in the JSON manifest format we use for auto-ingest. Example: {"temp_id":"TMP-2003-A","model":"A100-80GB","po":"PO-9812"} — please match keys.

NexaSupply - Laura: Understood. We'll include JSON lines in the packing scan and send both signed PDF manifest + JSON. ETA for docs upload: ~3 hours. Air AWB booked after docs processed.

ops-bot: RMA-9923 status updated: vendor docs pending -> vendor docs received at 2003456821 -> partial air booked 860-1234599 at 2003456845 -> warehouse hold updated.

Liam (Ops): Once docs land, Tara please coordinate courier to pick up air leg on arrival and call customs broker with HS code. Aj — I'll DM you temp IDs so you can dry-run allocation script.

Tara - Logistics: Will do. Also logging cost delta for finance: expedite_air: 3 * $1.2k = $3.6k, carrier_claim: TBD. Nexa please route final invoice to purchasing@redwood.com with claim reference.

NexaSupply - Laura: Will do. Sending docs now. Apologies for the mix-up — packing line had an automated label printer issue, we've fixed it and added a checksum step.

Maya P: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here. If air ETA slips, push to next-day surface and notify Aj. :thumbsup:
